deviation: The draft lets the SOW override the Parent Agreement wherever the SOW expressly says so, which breaks the playbook rule that lower documents may never dilute MSA liability, IP, data protection or audit terms. The draft also omits the standard statement that those MSA terms apply to the SOW, and it adds an entire-agreement clause that could supersede earlier protections.
suggested_text: 17.1 This SOW is issued under, and governed by, the Master Services Agreement (the Parent Agreement). If there is a conflict, the Master Services Agreement prevails over this SOW. The liability, indemnity, intellectual property, confidentiality, data protection, audit and governing law terms of the Master Services Agreement apply to this SOW. 17.2 Amendments to this SOW are effective only if in writing and signed by both parties, and no amendment to this SOW may modify or override any provision of the Master Services Agreement unless made as an amendment to the Master Services Agreement in accordance with its terms.
